headerDisplay: An infrared air conditioner behind an Aqara hub, as a HomeKit thermostat. AUTO holds the room between two temperatures using the hub's own thermometer.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region the account lives in, which is not always where you are - the device list is empty on the wrong one.

hubDid.title: Hub device id
hubDid.description: Only needed when the account has more than one hub with a matched air conditioner.

autoTargetTemperature.title: Setpoint used in AUTO
autoTargetTemperature.description: The band decides when the air conditioner runs; this decides how hard it works while it does.

autoFanSpeed.title: Fan speed used in AUTO
autoFanSpeed.description: 1 is Low, which is what the remote calls S1. AUTO always uses this, whether or not the slider is shown.

deadband.title: Deadband
deadband.description: How far past a threshold the room must go before anything is switched, so a sensor that jitters on the boundary does not cycle the unit.

temperatureStep.title: Slider step
temperatureStep.description: How finely the band can be set. The band is compared against the hub's own thermometer, so half a degree is meaningful even though the remote itself only takes whole ones.

refreshSeconds.title: How often to read the room

showHumidity.title: Show the hub's humidity as a sensor

showFanSpeed.title: Show a fan speed slider
showFanSpeed.description: Off by default: AUTO picks the speed itself, and a slider reports every position a finger passes through.

minTemperature.title: Coldest the band can be set to

maxTemperature.title: Warmest the band can be set to

settleMs.title: Wait after the band stops moving, ms
settleMs.description: Dragging the band sends no requests at all; this is how long after your finger stops before anything is acted on.
